test_flatten_density_profile: test flatten_profile.flatten_density_profile to flatten a density profile within a mixing radius while conserving volume integral
test_flatten_temperature_profile: test flatten_profile.flatten_temperature_profile to flatten a temperature profile while conserving total pressure integral
test_flatten_current_profile: test flatten_profile.flatten_current_profile to flatten a current profile and verify approximate current conservation
